review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for uses of pointBot, pointBotFunctor, pointBotPresheafFiberIso and pointsBot. The only uses are inside this file. The simp interface here is small. pointBot and pointBotFunctor use @[simps], and pointBotPresheafFiberIso uses @[simps! inv], which exposes only the inverse direction. That gives a single canonical orientation with no competing rules, and I found no sign of a cycle. pointsBot has no simp or mem lemma. Its only use is `dsimp [pointsBot]` in the Small instance, which is a single use and isn't enough to justify a new simp lemma. I did not run Lean, so I can't rule out simp failures I haven't seen.
